 Hand Crossbows are a type of one-handed martial ranged weapon. The following are some base attributes common to most hand crossbows, although special or magical variants may be significantly different. For the most common, nonmagical type of this weapon, see Hand Crossbow. Further down below, you can find a list of all hand crossbows in the game.

Properties

Damage
1d6 (1~6) + Dexterity modifier ⁠Piercing
Details
 One-Handed
 Range: 15 m (50 ft)
 Light
 Dippable

Actions

If you have proficiency, equip in main hand to gain:

 Piercing Shot ()
Deal regular damage and possibly inflict  Gaping Wounds which cause extra damage on attacks. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
 Mobile Shot ()
After using  Dash or  Disengage this turn, you can make a ranged attack as a bonus action. ( Recharge: Short rest.)
